name: Lightning
desc: Multiple branching violet-white bolts fork out of a dim storm sky and re-strike frequently, each with a near-white hot core inside a wide colored glow, flickering and fading to afterglow while the cloud briefly flashes — recolorable as crimson, ice-blue, toxic-green, or a flat cyan schematic blueprint.

energy.doc: core/glow brightness + strike-flash amplitude (max = blinding bolts)

density.doc: number of simultaneous bolts (1..7) filling the frame

strike.doc: re-strike frequency (how often bolts flash to a fresh path)

branch.doc: forkiness: low = straight whip bolts, high = bushy branching tree

hue.doc: bolt hue (storm style only; named styles fix their own color)

style.doc: render philosophy: violet/white storm bolts / red ember / cold cyan / acid green / flat schematic wiring diagram (mono, no bloom)

alpha.doc: opacity for VJ compositing (100=opaque bg, lower=translucent overlay)
